entities.createSql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `${TABLE_NAME}` (`id` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL, `day` TEXT NOT NULL, `createdAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `updatedAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `preview` TEXT NOT NULL, `body` TEXT NOT NULL)

indices.name: index_journal_doc_day
indices.createSql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_journal_doc_day` ON `${TABLE_NAME}` (`day`)

contentSyncTriggers: CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_journal_fts_BEFORE_UPDATE BEFORE UPDATE ON `journal_doc` BEGIN DELETE FROM `journal_fts` WHERE `docid`=OLD.`rowid`; END
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_journal_fts_BEFORE_DELETE BEFORE DELETE ON `journal_doc` BEGIN DELETE FROM `journal_fts` WHERE `docid`=OLD.`rowid`; END
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_journal_fts_AFTER_UPDATE AFTER UPDATE ON `journal_doc` BEGIN INSERT INTO `journal_fts`(`docid`, `body`) VALUES (NEW.`rowid`, NEW.`body`); END
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_journal_fts_AFTER_INSERT AFTER INSERT ON `journal_doc` BEGIN INSERT INTO `journal_fts`(`docid`, `body`) VALUES (NEW.`rowid`, NEW.`body`); END
entities.createSql: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `${TABLE_NAME}` USING FTS4(`body` TEXT NOT NULL, tokenize=unicode61, content=`journal_doc`)
